improvements.title: Add README.md
improvements.rationale: README provides essential project documentation for onboarding and maintenance.
improvements.suggested_change: Create README.md with: project description, setup instructions, available scripts, deployment notes, and contribution guidelines.

improvements.title: Add test suite
improvements.rationale: No test files detected. Tests catch regressions and improve refactoring confidence.
improvements.suggested_change: Add vitest or jest config, then write unit tests for critical utilities and integration tests for key user flows.

improvements.title: Add CI workflow
improvements.rationale: No GitHub Actions workflow detected. CI automates linting, testing, and deployment checks.
improvements.suggested_change: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with install, lint, test, and build steps. Use pnpm for consistency.

improvements.title: Add Next.js build and typecheck scripts
improvements.rationale: Next.js projects benefit from explicit build and typecheck scripts in CI.
improvements.suggested_change: Add scripts: build, typecheck, lint. Ensure CI runs all three.

improvements.title: Add error boundaries
improvements.rationale: Next.js App Router benefits from error.tsx and global-error.tsx to gracefully handle runtime failures.
improvements.suggested_change: Add app/error.tsx and app/global-error.tsx with user-friendly fallback UI and error reporting.

improvements.title: Add loading states
improvements.rationale: Loading UI improves perceived performance and prevents layout shift.
improvements.suggested_change: Add loading.tsx for routes with async data fetching. Use skeleton components matching the final UI.
